title: POST /api/v1/feed/sessions success
description: How many sessions are stored for the machine now, and what more the cloud takes in a session list (`accepts`).

accepts.description: What the cloud takes in `sessions-upload` beyond its first version, so a machine sends it only once the cloud said so; absent from a cloud that takes nothing more. Known: `places` (`sessionState` `places`). Machines ignore names they don't know.
